description: Dynamic review criteria for Claude PR reviews. Update this file to change what Claude focuses on during reviews.
criteria: system architecture, approach to project and planning excellence, code quality

foundation.criteria: system architecture, approach to project and planning excellence, code quality
foundation.description: For foundational PRs (Week 1-2): Focus on architecture decisions, planning, and code quality

feature.criteria: code quality, test coverage, API design, security
feature.description: For feature PRs: Focus on implementation quality, testing, and security

refactor.criteria: code maintainability, performance, technical debt reduction
refactor.description: For refactoring PRs: Focus on code improvements and performance

bugfix.criteria: root cause analysis, test coverage for regression, edge cases
bugfix.description: For bug fixes: Focus on proper fixes and preventing regressions

docs.description: For documentation PRs: Focus on quality of documentation

security.criteria: security vulnerabilities, authentication/authorization, input validation, data protection
security.description: For security-focused PRs: Deep security review

how_to_change: To change review criteria, update the 'criteria' field above
You can use a preset by copying its 'criteria' value
Or create custom criteria as comma-separated focus areas
Commit this file to apply criteria to future PR reviews
instructions.example_custom: performance optimization, memory management, caching strategies

notes: Claude will always check for basic code quality issues
Custom criteria adds additional focus areas on top of basics
Review criteria can be overridden per-PR using labels (future enhancement)
